title: Deep Reinforcement Learning for HPC Job Scheduling: A Statistical Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2610.21008v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) offers learned job selection for High-Performance Computing (HPC), but performance against heuristics alone does not establish value beyond action masking. Six DRL treatments are compared: Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), Advantage Actor-Critic (A2C), and Deep Q-Network (DQN), each with and without masking. Three heuristics and a seed-paired masked uniform random control provide baselines across ten seeds on two real Slurm (Simple Linux Utility for Resource Management) workload traces, one homogeneous and one heterogeneous, under a common non-parametric framework. All masked treatments complete evaluation, whereas unmasked treatments are truncated. On the homogeneous trace, no masked DRL treatment significantly improves average waiting time or average and maximum bounded slowdown over the control. translated_title: 用于高性能计算作业调度的深度强化学习：一项统计评估
translated_abstract: 深度强化学习为高性能计算（HPC）提供了一种可学习的作业选择方法，但仅与启发式算法的性能比较并不能确立其在动作掩码之外的价值。本研究比较了六种深度强化学习方案：近端策略优化（PPO）、优势行动者-评论家（A2C）和深度Q网络（DQN），每种方法分别采用和不采用掩码。三种启发式算法和一个种子配对的掩码均匀随机对照作为基准，在统一的非参数统计框架下，基于两个真实的Slurm工作负载跟踪（一个同构、一个异构）在十个随机种子上进行评估。所有带掩码的方案均完成了评估，而不带掩码的方案则被截断。在同构跟踪上，没有带掩码的深度强化学习方案在平均等待时间或平均和最大有界慢化方面显著优于随机对照。在异构跟踪上，MaskablePPO在全部三项指标上均显著优于对照。其平均等待时间…（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本研究通过严格的统计评估发现，带动作掩码的深度强化学习方法仅在异构HPC工作负载上（MaskablePPO）能显著改善调度性能，而在同构工作负载上并未超越掩码随机对照。
en_tdlr: A rigorous statistical evaluation reveals that masked DRL (specifically MaskablePPO) significantly improves HPC job scheduling only on heterogeneous workloads, showing no significant advantage over masked random control on homogeneous workloads.
